portInfo.description: A city on the French Riviera, known for its beautiful Promenade des Anglais, Mediterranean climate, and cultural attractions.

climate.description: Mediterranean climate with hot, dry summers and mild winters

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Budget 30 minutes from the ship through the confirmed exit towards the Castle Hill/old-town circuit; allow 30–45 minutes to regain the exact gate and complete security. Use an agreed road transfer for Cimiez, budgeting 45 minutes each way rather than claiming it is a flat waterfront stroll. The operator’s shuttle/tram references are not a current frequency/fare promise.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Castle Hill park — Parc de la Colline du Château, Nice. A viewpoint/park with steep approaches; verify the accessible option. Allow 75 minutes; [official source](https://www.explorenicecotedazur.com/en/explore/towns-villages/coastal-area/nice/what-to-do-in-nice/).

Cours Saleya — Cours Saleya, Vieux-Nice. The market street is a useful fixed meeting landmark; market days/hours vary. Allow 45 minutes; [official source](https://www.explorenicecotedazur.com/en/explore/towns-villages/coastal-area/nice/what-to-do-in-nice/).

Sainte-Réparate Cathedral — Place Rossetti, Vieux-Nice. Church entry is subject to worship; the square remains an outdoor target. Allow 35 minutes; [official source](https://www.explorenicecotedazur.com/en/explore/towns-villages/coastal-area/nice/what-to-do-in-nice/).

Vieux-Nice lanes — Old town between Place Rossetti and Cours Saleya, Nice. Choose a small loop instead of losing the return meeting point. Allow 60 minutes; [official source](https://www.explorenicecotedazur.com/en/explore/towns-villages/coastal-area/nice/what-to-do-in-nice/).

Promenade des Anglais / Rauba Capeu — Seafront at Quai Rauba Capeu and the Promenade des Anglais, Nice. A seafront walk with sun exposure, not an assurance of swimming conditions. Allow 60 minutes; [official source](https://www.explorenicecotedazur.com/en/explore/towns-villages/coastal-area/nice/what-to-do-in-nice/).
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Keep the precise port name on the transport booking. “Nice” in a regional excursion description does not prove that the ship is at Lympia rather than Villefranche.
